articles.title: Elden Ring On Switch 2 Is A Compromise, But It’s A Surprisingly Good One
articles.title_tr: Elden Ring On Switch 2 Is A Compromise, But It’s A Surprisingly Good One
articles.summary:
Elden Ring was in rough shape on Switch 2 when people first tried it out last year, leading publisher Bandai Namco to significantly delay its launch plans. It's now 2026, and ahead of its new release date of August 28, has that extra time in the development oven helped smooth out Elden Ring on the Nintendo hybrid console? Yes--but only to a certain point.



Senior video producer Jake Dekker has spent over a week with the game, playing it in both docked and handheld modes. The key takeaway is that Elden Ring runs at a consistent frame rate, but not the highest one.



"While there are certainly frame rate drops, it never hits the lows that we saw in some of that preview footage," Dekker explained. It runs a lot better. That being said, the frame rate is still far from perfect. I've done most of my playing docked, but I've also done some handheld, and you definitely notice those frame rate drops here and there. I don't think it's so bad that it's distracting or unplayable. But for those who played Elden Ring on PC, Xbox Series X, or PlayStation 5, you're definitely going to notice the frame rate. It's not hitting that smooth 60 frames per second that we saw in those versions. And to be honest, that is a little disappointing."




https://youtu.be/Z73iKl-hlNA




Bandai Namco hasn't officially confirmed the resolution and frame rate targets for Elden Ring on Switch 2 yet, but so far it looks like the game mostly hits a consistent 30fps in docked mode. While 60fps would make some of the tougher boss fights a little easier to handle--considering just how important timing is in them--having the game run at a cinematic frame rate doesn't make it unplayable. If you don't mind seeing a smaller number of frames per second, you'll still be in for a good time, as the Tarnished Edition on Switch 2 includes both Elden Ring and its critically acclaimed Shadow of the Erdtree expansion.



That's a chunky amount of content for $80, and this version of the game throws in new skins for your steed Torrent, unique in-game armor sets and skins, and two new classes: the Heavy Knight and the Idus Knight. But if you've already played a lot of Elden Ring in the last couple of years, your mileage may vary on the value proposition--plus, you can stick to a version of the game that offers more technical options for enjoying its visuals on PC, PlayStation, and Xbox.



And if the 30fps frame rate is a dealbreaker for you? From Software's The Duskbloods should satisfy that craving for a 60fps souls-like experience when it eventually launches for Switch 2, as early gameplay looks promising.

articles.title: The Most Expensive Xbox Ever Now Includes Another Special Perk
articles.title_tr: The Most Expensive Xbox Ever Now Includes Another Special Perk
articles.summary:
Microsoft has announced that preorders for the 25th-anniversary edition of the Xbox Series X are now open (at least to some), and if you want one, it's going to cost you. 



As rumored, the 1TB console will cost $900, which is $100 more than the standard Xbox Series X. It features a translucent green design and sports an "Xbox 25" logo to celebrate the milestone. The bundle comes with a special-edition 25th-anniversary translucent green Xbox controller as well. Each console unit is individually numbered.




https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1-INYU6FLgI




Additionally, Microsoft has announced that all of the 25th anniversary Xbox consoles will include a download code for Halo: Campaign Evolved.  



The game launched in July, and while Halo's co-creator had some issues with it, he and others, including us here at GameSpot, generally enjoyed the remake. It's also the first Halo game on PlayStation.



The translucent green Xbox Series X launches in November.



Microsoft is opening up preorders today, August 26, for "some of Xbox's most dedicated fans." Everyone else, meanwhile, can try to get their hands on one starting August 27 at 7 AM PT / 10 AM ET through Xbox or other retailers.



The console will become available, for anyone who secures a preorder, starting November 13. People can only preorder one. 



If you just want the controller, preorders are open now for the $80 gamepad. It releases on October 20.



The 25th anniversary Xbox controller.



$900 is a lot of money, but it's not actually the most expensive anniversary-themed console we've seen. That record belongs to Sony's PS5 Pro 30th anniversary limited edition bundle, which retailed for a whopping $1,000 in 2024.

articles.title: PlayStation Plus Free Games For September 2026 Revealed
articles.title_tr: PlayStation Plus Free Games For September 2026 Revealed
articles.summary:
PlayStation has revealed this month's batch of free games for PlayStation Plus subscribers. All PS Plus members will be able to claim four freebies starting September 1--Sniper Elite: Resistance, MLB The Show 26, Chained Echoes, and Wobbly Life. If you haven't claimed August's PlayStation Plus free games yet, make sure to do so before next Tuesday.



Sniper Elite: Resistance is the main event for September, and if you haven't checked out this series yet, then you've missed out on a gruesomely fun World War II adventure. Set behind enemy lines in occupied France, players will get to take on the Axis forces, one bullet at a time. Like the previous games, kills are highlighted in all their gory detail, and when you don't feel like taking out enemies from a long distance, there are plenty of options you can utilize to remove Nazis up close.



For something completely different, you can also aim for baseball glory in MLB The Show 26. This year's entry in the annual series plays to its strengths, offering authentic gameplay, evolved features, new stadium effects, and more as you play through various leagues from across multiple eras of baseball. If you're in the mood for a game that involves friends, you can check out Wobbly Life for some co-op chaos, as your gang explores an open-world sandbox full of diversions. You can also play it solo, but what's the fun in that?



Finally, Chained Echoes is a single-player JRPG featuring a group of heroes exploring the vast continent of Valandis. With three kingdoms waging war, it's up to these heroes to use their swords, magic, and mechs to end the conflict in this tribute to 16-bit era fantasy games.
